description: Cancel a running training job by owner/project/model, ul://owner/project/model, or slug with a project. Cancelling releases the compute instance; elapsed GPU time is still charged and the most recently uploaded checkpoint is preserved rather than discarded. This stops the job and does not delete the model.

model.description: Model ref by owner/project/model, ul:// URI, or slug (requires project).

project.description: Project ref required when model is given by slug.

name: training_cancel
